summary: John Daniel Huisjen, 24, of Durango, mountain biking the East Fork Trail in the Lizard Head Wilderness (~17 mi south of Telluride) with his girlfriend, was struck and killed by lightning just before noon Sunday; off-duty EMT and bystanders performed CPR; deputies, Telluride EMS and SAR hiked ~half mile to the scene but life-saving efforts failed; girlfriend treated and transported for non-life-threatening injuries
location: East Fork Trail, Lizard Head Wilderness
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office (deputies + SAR); Telluride EMS
notes: Date per the quoted San Miguel Sheriff's Department release (Aug 13, 2017 — Sunday, weekday-verified); girlfriend survived with non-life-threatening injuries; San Miguel County Coroner released the victim's name; run-948 insert via SMCSO news-alerts chunk
